text:
sara-peopleops: Hi team  quick question about enrolling our newly adopted child. Final adoption decree was issued in South Africa on 2026-01-20 and we returned with the child last week. Can we add the child retroactive to the decree date? What docs do you need if we only have the foreign decree and a passport but the US immigration paperwork is still in process?
kevin: Congrats! :tada: I had a similar timeline last year, we added retro to placement date. Tagging @noah-benefits to confirm exact docs/timing.
adoption-bot: Adoption guidance: https://hr.redwood.example/adoptions (includes doc checklist, timelines for domestic vs. international). Processing SLA: 3-7 business days after docs submitted.
noah-benefits: Congrats and welcome to the family! Short version: yes, you can request retroactive coverage. For international adoptions we typically accept two of the following to process an initial enrollment:
- Official foreign adoption decree (certified copy)
- Child passport or provisional travel document
- Proof of final custody/placement from the foreign court or agency letter
- US immigration receipt or Form I-800/I-797 (when available)
If immigration paperwork is pending, the foreign decree + passport are usually sufficient to add the child provisionally. We do require final US immigration/adoption documentation when it becomes available.
sara-peopleops: Good to know. Is there a specific QLE window we should use for adoption? I remember placement vs finalization rules differ.
noah-benefits: Right  adoption timelines vary: if the child was placed with you before finalization, you have 30 days from the placement date to report that placement as a QLE; if full legal finalization occurred abroad on 2026-01-20 then the QLE window is 30 days from that finalization date. If you miss the 30-day window, we can still enroll but it may be treated as a mid-year change and require extra approvals. Best to submit now.
adoption-bot: Note: SSN can be provided later. For tax-dependent verification, provide SSN within 60 days if possible. See: https://payroll.redwood.example/ssn-dependent.
sara-peopleops: Thanks. How will payroll handle retro premiums? Any chance for a lump refund instead of deduction?
noah-benefits: Payroll adjustments: coverage effective date will be the finalization or placement date per what you choose when reporting. Premiums will be reconciled retroactively in the next 1-2 pay cycles after benefits processes the event. Depending on timing you may see either a one-time deduction (if premiums were underpaid) or a small refund (if we over-collected). If you prefer, ask payroll for a refund timeline and they can split adjustments over two runs.
kevin: FYI, make sure to toggle dental/vision in the portal  those are not automatic. Also add child to dependent life insurance if needed.
sara-peopleops: Where do I upload the foreign decree + passport? I tried "Report life event" but not sure which event to pick.
noah-benefits: Steps: 1) HR Portal > Benefits > Report a Life Event 2) Choose "Add dependent  adoption/placement" 3) Enter date of placement/finalization (2026-01-20) and relationship: child 4) Upload files (you can attach multiple PDFs) 5) In notes write: "International adoption  foreign decree + passport attached; US immigration pending" If you prefer, open a case and cc benefits@redwood.example and reference case #ADP-45218.
sara-peopleops: Perfect. Do we need certified translations for the decree?
noah-benefits: Certified translation is preferred for any documents not in English; apostille is not required for our intake. If the foreign decree is in English or already has an official translation, that's fine.
sara-peopleops: Great, uploading now. Appreciate the quick help :heart:
adoption-bot: Case created: #ADP-45218. Expected processing: 3-7 business days after docs received.
